svg.title: A grid of 176 cells, in rows of 38. The frames step through 10 facts. No cell among the first 89 ever flips. Above them, each edit flips a few cells.
svg.text: Each edit flips a few poles above layer 2,
and none at or below it
Each cell is one of pythia-70m's 176 VERIFIED poles, by layer, nearest a gate first within each.
The first 89 cells are layers 0 to 2. Circles flip under ROME, triangles under the random edit.
Shaded cells are layers 0 to 2, which the edit cannot change.
